user_reproduction: Pause, next and previous buttons failed before dispatch with media_target_changed.
root_cause: RequestAsync was repeated for reads and controls. Separate GSMTC managers exposed unequal session identities for the same underlying player, causing false stale-target rejection.
change: The existing Media owner retains the issuing Agile manager privately, reuses it across polls and worker controls, and discards it on transport loss. Empty current sessions retain the manager. Session/metadata/capability and cancellation checks remain active.

validation.ui_regression_scope: No UI code changed in this fix; preceding slice passed 9 JS suites and 18 browser groups. Native UI/core checks rerun in all ten phases.

new_regressions: All four actions use manager-local wrappers across repeated polls and a separate TaskManager worker thread.
Target remains stable on unchanged samples; native references never enter JSON.
An empty current session retains its manager while invalidating the old target.
A failed source drops the manager; a later read reacquires it without performing playback actions.
initial_failures: Pyright flagged unpacking an optional cached sample after the fix. The stale-target guard now explicitly rejects missing cached samples; final type check passed.
limits: Original synthetic fixtures returned the same session identity for every manager activation and therefore missed this real Windows behavior. Dedicated manager-local identity regressions now cover it.
Actual playback mutation/provider acceptance remains pending; real probes were read-only or cancelled before dispatch.
Existing same-title skip/previous-restart verification limits, persistent unknown locking and the earlier native teardown/type-complexity boundaries are unchanged.
No paid API, production credentials or real note data were used; the portable EXE was not rebuilt.
manual_retest: User reported all media tests successful after the identity fix; actual provider coverage was not specified.
commit: Accepted by user; committed before requested next step under AGENTS.md
